# KumikoUI — Architecture & Project Structure

## What This Is

**KumikoUI** is a high-performance, fully canvas-drawn DataGrid for **.NET MAUI** and the **Uno Platform**. Every visual
element is rendered on a SkiaSharp `SKCanvas`: zero native UIKit / AppKit / WinUI controls, the same output on iOS,
Android, Mac Catalyst, Windows, desktop (Skia) and WebAssembly. The long form is
[docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

---

## Four Packages, Three Layers

```
KumikoUI.Core         net10.0         platform-agnostic models, layout, input, editing, rendering pipeline
KumikoUI.SkiaSharp    net10.0         IDrawingContext → SKCanvas, resource cache, font registry, image cache
KumikoUI.Maui         net10.0-*       KumikoDataGrid for .NET MAUI (ContentView on an SKGLView or SKCanvasView)
KumikoUI.Uno          net10.0-*       KumikoDataGrid for Uno (UserControl on an SKCanvasElement or SKXamlCanvas)
KumikoUI.SourceGenerators             the [KumikoGridItem] generator, shipped inside the KumikoUI.Core package
```

**Dependency direction: strict, never violate:**
```
KumikoUI.Core  ←  KumikoUI.SkiaSharp  ←  KumikoUI.Maui
                                      ←  KumikoUI.Uno
```
The two hosts never reference each other.

| Layer | May reference | Must NOT reference |
|---|---|---|
| `KumikoUI.Core` | BCL only | SkiaSharp, MAUI, WinUI/Uno, any platform SDK |
| `KumikoUI.SkiaSharp` | Core + `SkiaSharp` NuGet (+ HarfBuzz) | MAUI, WinUI/Uno, platform SDKs |
| `KumikoUI.Maui` | Core, SkiaSharp, MAUI | `KumikoUI.Uno` |
| `KumikoUI.Uno` | Core, SkiaSharp, Uno / WinUI | `KumikoUI.Maui` |

A fix or feature that both hosts need belongs in Core (or SkiaSharp), with its tests there. The Uno and MAUI hosts mirror each
other: same properties, events and defaults.

## Project Paths

| Purpose | Path |
|---|---|
| Core models, layout, input, editing, rendering abstractions | `src/KumikoUI.Core/` |
| SkiaSharp drawing context, caches, fonts | `src/KumikoUI.SkiaSharp/` |
| MAUI control + hosting | `src/KumikoUI.Maui/` |
| Uno control | `src/KumikoUI.Uno/` |
| `[KumikoGridItem]` source generator | `src/KumikoUI.SourceGenerators/` |
| Sample apps (shared data in `samples/Shared`) | `samples/SampleApp.Maui/`, `samples/SampleApp.Uno/` |
| xUnit tests | `tests/KumikoUI.Core.Tests/`, `tests/KumikoUI.SkiaSharp.Tests/`, `tests/KumikoUI.Maui.Tests/`, `tests/KumikoUI.Uno.Tests/`, `tests/KumikoUI.SourceGenerators.Tests/` |
| Compiled documentation snippets | `tests/KumikoUI.Docs.Snippets.Maui/`, `tests/KumikoUI.Docs.Snippets.Uno/` (generated by `eng/DocsSnippets`) |
| Build tools (not shipped) | `eng/TypeNameCheck`, `eng/DocsSnippets`, `eng/DocsIdentifiers`, `eng/devflow` |

## Code Style (applies everywhere)

- **C# 12+**, nullable reference types enabled project-wide.
- All public API members have `/// <summary>` XML doc comments (`<inheritdoc/>` for overrides, one per enum member). The libraries build with doc warnings as errors (`Directory.Build.targets`), so an undocumented public member or a broken `cref` fails the build.
- Public type names: no new public type starts with `Grid`, and none shares a simple name with a MAUI, WinUI or Uno type; use the `Kumiko` prefix (or a `Drawn...` name for a drawn component). `eng/TypeNameCheck` enforces it in CI.
- Leaf types are `sealed`. Core events are `EventHandler` / `EventHandler<T>`.
- `readonly struct` for value types (`KumikoRect`, `KumikoSize`, `CellPosition`); `readonly record struct` for `KumikoFont` and cache keys in `SkiaResourceCache`.
- Prefer `switch` expressions over `if/else` chains for type dispatch.
- **No LINQ and no allocation** inside render-loop hot paths: use `for` loops and pre-allocated lists. `RenderAllocationTests` and `SkiaAllocationTests` fail on a per-frame allocation.
- Use `float` for all coordinate/dimension math (not `double`).
- Use `KumikoColor(r, g, b[, a])` everywhere: never hex strings, never `SKColor`, never `Color` from MAUI.
- American English in code, comments, docs and commit messages.
